granularity_mapping: model text classes (text_bubble+text_free) -> one merge input each ('word' role) -> frozen production cluster_words_into_blocks (MERGE_PAD_PX=6) -> judged block layer; bubble class dropped (balloon shape, not text); identical merge+scoring path as the fast_base / db_resnet50 baselines
manifest_gt_provenance: dataset auxiliary annotations (pseudo-GT, not human annotation). seg05/GT-A: info.json text_boxes where model=='text_seg' and score>=0.5. union/GT-B: merged text_seg(>=0.3) + text_ctd + uncleaned_boxes, greedy union merge at IoU>=0.5. union manifests also carry supplementary_boxes = auxiliary text evidence outside GT for FP attribution.

thresholds.comment: M2-DOCTR-QUAL thresholds — user ruling 2026-09-30 (binds the formal qualification run). Primary judging = coverage on production merged blocks with production pad (MERGE_PAD_PX=6) as the FORMAL result; pad-offset (strip 6px) reported alongside as diagnostic. Precision is a POLLUTION-BOUNDED OBSERVATION ONLY (SFX/background-text annotation blind spot) and is NOT a gate. Recognition outputs are never consulted.
thresholds.pad_protocol: production_pad_6px_is_formal; pad-offset (strip 6px per side) reported as diagnostic

non_gate_observations.precision_note: pollution-bounded lower bound (GT blind spot: SFX/background text unannotated); reported, never gates

thresholds.severe_page_miss_definition: on the primary layer (block_coverage): a region with >= severe_page_miss_min_gt GT boxes and zero matched detections; rate is over regions that contain at least one GT box

fp_attribution_block_coverage.note: FPs scored against manifest supplementary_boxes (auxiliary text evidence outside the GT subset); Jaccard IoU>=0.3 counts as GT-coverage FP, otherwise pure. seg05 manifests carry no supplementary_boxes, so attribution is unavailable (not 'all pure').

verdict_vs_default_thresholds.judging_layer: block_coverage (production merged blocks vs block-level GT, coverage = intersection/gt_area >= 0.5); raw_strict kept for granularity diagnosis only, never judged
